targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.id AS poi_id,
  ts.id AS supercharger_id,
  ts.common_site_name AS name,
  ts.location_slug,
  ts.location_guid,
  ts.site_status,
  ts.access_type,
  ts.open_to_public,
  ts.open_to_non_teslas,
  ts.trailer_friendly,
  ts.twenty_four_seven,
  ts.region,
  ts.country,
  ts.info_url,
  ts.created_at,
  ts.updated_at,
  now() - ts.updated_at AS catalog_age,
  ts.stall_count,
  ts.max_power_kw,
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ts.pricebooks) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(ts.pricebooks) ELSE 0 END AS pricebook_count,
  (ts.detail_payload IS NOT NULL AND ts.detail_payload <> '{}'::jsonb) AS detail_captured
FROM tesla_superchargers ts
JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.tesla_supercharger_id = ts.id
JOIN pois p ON p.id = pts.poi_id
WHERE ts.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.poi_type = 'tesla_supercharger'
  AND COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '');

SELECT
  p.id AS poi_id,
  ts.id AS supercharger_id,
  ts.common_site_name AS name,
  ts.location_slug,
  ts.region,
  ts.country,
  ts.stall_count,
  ts.max_power_kw,
  ts.site_status,
  ts.access_type,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
FROM tesla_superchargers ts
JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.tesla_supercharger_id = ts.id
JOIN pois p ON p.id = pts.poi_id
WHERE ts.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.poi_type = 'tesla_supercharger'
  AND COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '');

SELECT
  ts.time_zone,
  ts.address->>'street' AS street,
  ts.address->>'city' AS city,
  ts.address->>'state' AS state,
  ts.address->>'country' AS country,
  ts.address->>'postcode' AS postal_code,
  ts.amenities,
  ts.hardware_counts,
  ts.index_payload->'supercharger_function' AS index_status
FROM tesla_superchargers ts
JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.tesla_supercharger_id = ts.id
JOIN pois p ON p.id = pts.poi_id
WHERE ts.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.poi_type = 'tesla_supercharger'
  AND COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '');

SELECT
  e.row_num,
  e.pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' AS vehicle_make_type,
  e.pricebook->>'feeType' AS fee_type,
  e.pricebook->>'currencyCode' AS currency,
  e.pricebook->>'uom' AS unit,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateBase', '')::numeric AS rate_base,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateTier1', '')::numeric AS rate_tier_1,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateTier2', '')::numeric AS rate_tier_2,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'minSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS min_site_occupancy,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'maxSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS max_site_occupancy,
  e.pricebook->>'isMemberPricebook' AS member_pricebook,
  e.pricebook AS raw_pricebook
FROM tesla_superchargers ts
JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.tesla_supercharger_id = ts.id
JOIN pois p ON p.id = pts.poi_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ts.pricebooks) = 'array' THEN ts.pricebooks ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(pricebook, row_num)
WHERE ts.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.poi_type = 'tesla_supercharger'
  AND COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
ORDER BY e.row_num ASC;

panels.description: TSLA TOU charging rates by hour of day. Empty if the site has no time-of-use pricebooks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tou AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateBase','')::numeric AS rate_base,
    split_part(e.pricebook->>'startTime', ':', 1)::int AS start_hour,
    split_part(e.pricebook->>'endTime', ':', 1)::int AS end_hour
  FROM tesla_superchargers ts
  JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.tesla_supercharger_id = ts.id
  JOIN pois p ON p.id = pts.poi_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ts.pricebooks) = 'array' THEN ts.pricebooks ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS e(pricebook)
  WHERE ts.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.poi_type = 'tesla_supercharger'
    AND COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND p.id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${supercharger_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
    AND (e.pricebook->>'isTou')::bool = true
    AND e.pricebook->>'feeType' = 'CHARGING'
    AND e.pricebook->>'uom' = 'kwh'
    AND e.pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' = 'TSLA'
    AND NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'startTime','') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'endTime','') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  hour,
  avg(t.rate_base) AS rate_base
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS hour
LEFT JOIN tou t
  ON CASE
       WHEN t.start_hour <= t.end_hour
         THEN hour >= t.start_hour AND hour < t.end_hour
       ELSE hour >= t.start_hour OR hour < t.end_hour
     END
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;

list.definition:
SELECT __text, __value
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS sort_key, 'No supercharger selected' AS __text, '__no_supercharger' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_key,
    ts.common_site_name || ' - POI ' || p.id::text || COALESCE(' [' || NULLIF(ts.region, '') || ']', '') AS __text,
    p.id::text AS __value
  FROM tesla_superchargers ts
  JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.tesla_supercharger_id = ts.id
  JOIN pois p ON p.id = pts.poi_id
  WHERE ts.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.poi_type = 'tesla_supercharger'
    AND (
      '$__searchFilter' = '%'
      OR p.id::text ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR ts.common_site_name ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR ts.location_slug ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
      OR ts.region ILIKE '$__searchFilter'
    )
) options
ORDER BY sort_key, __text
LIMIT 5001;
